verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              शरविक्षतगात्रस्तु प्रत्यमित्रमवस्थितम्।  अभिमन्युः स्मयन् श्रीमान् दुःशासनमथाब्रवीत्॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Then the highly intelligent Abhimanyu with his body mangled with arrow-wounds smilingly addressing his antagonist Dushasana stationed before him, spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: दिष्ट्या पश्यामि संग्रामे मानिनं शूरमागतम्। निष्ठुरं त्यक्तधर्माणमाक्रोशनपरायणम्॥२॥
verses.english: "It is by good luck that today I find before me that vain warrior of cruel deeds and lost righteousness who ever brays loudly in his own applause.

verses.sanskrit: यत्सभायां त्वया राज्ञो धृतराष्ट्रस्य शृण्वतः।  कोपितः परुषैर्वाक्यैर्धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥३॥
जयोन्मत्तेन भीमश्च बह्वबद्धं प्रभाषितः।  अक्षकूटं समाश्रित्य सौबलस्यात्मनो बलम्॥४॥
तत्त्ववेद‌मनुप्राप्तं तस्य कोपान्महात्मनः।  परवित्तापहारस्य क्रोधस्याप्रशमस्य च॥५॥
verses.english: In consequence of all these acts and in consequence of the wrath of all those illustrious heroes, the present fate has overtaken you. O wicked-minded one, to you now reap the fatal fruits of your robbery of other peoples' possessions, of your wrathful temperaments, of your hatred for peace, of your covetousness, of your ignorance, harmfullness and persecution of others, as also of depriving my sires, all fierce bowmen, of their kingdom and of your own unrighteousness, This day before the eyes of all these warriors I will chastise you with my arrows.

verses.sanskrit: लोभस्य ज्ञाननाशस्य द्रोहस्यात्याहितस्य च।  पितॄणां मम राज्यस्य हरणस्योग्रधन्विनाम्॥६॥
तत्त्वयेद‌मनुप्राप्तं प्रकोपाद्वै महात्मनाम्।  स तस्योग्रमधर्मस्य फलं प्राप्नुहि दुर्मते॥७॥
शासितास्म्यद्य ते बाणैः सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः।  अद्याहमनृणस्तस्य कोपस्य भविता रणे॥८॥
verses.english: This day I will free myself from the burden of anger I bear against you, as also from the debt I owe to my sires and to the angry Krishna, who ever desire your death.

verses.sanskrit: अमर्षितायाः कृष्णायाः कांक्षितस्य च मे पितुः।  अद्य कौरव्य भीमस्य भविताऽस्म्यनृणो युधि॥९॥
verses.english: Today, O descendant of the Kuru race, I will in battle pay off the debt I owe to Bhima; you shall not this day escape me with life, provided you do not abandon the fight.

verses.sanskrit: न हि मे मोक्ष्यसे जीवन्यदि नोत्सृजसे रणम्।  एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्बाणं दुःशासनान्तकम्॥१०॥
verses.english: Having thus spoken, that mighty-armed hero, that slayer of hostile heroes, fixed on his bow-string an arrow, endued with with the effulgence of Yama, Fire or the Windgod and calculated to bring about Dushasana's death.

verses.sanskrit: संद‌धे परवीरघ्नः कालाग्न्यनिलवर्चसम्।  तस्योरस्तूर्णमासाद्य जत्रुदेशे विभिद्य तम्॥११॥
verses.english: Flying towards Dushasana's breast, that arrow pierced his shoulder-joint up to the very bones, like a snake piercing into an ant hill.

verses.sanskrit: जगाम सह पुङ्खेन वल्मीकमिव पन्नगः।  अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या पुनरेव समार्पयत्॥१२॥
शरैरग्निसमस्पर्शैराकर्णसमचोदितैः।  स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो रथोपस्य उपाविशत्॥१३॥
verses.english: Thus deeply pierced and painted to the extreme, Dushasana squatted down on the terrace of his chariot and, O mighty monarch, he became unconscious in a swoon.

verses.sanskrit: दुःशासनो महाराज कश्मलं चाविशन्महत्।  सारथिस्त्वरमाणस्तु दुःशासनमचेतनम्॥१४॥
verses.english: Thereupon his charioteer quickly carried the field the unconscious Dushasana who had been sorely afflicted by Abhimanyu's arrows.

verses.sanskrit: रणमध्यादपोवाह सौभद्रशरपीडितम्।  पाण्डवा द्रौपदेयाश्च विराटश्च समीक्ष्य तम्॥१५॥
verses.english: The Pandavas, the sons of Draupadi and Virat and the Kekayas and the Panchalas, beholding that act of Subhadra's son sent up a loud roar like that of a lion.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चालाः केकयाश्चैव सिंहनादमथानदन्।  वादित्राणि च सर्वाणि नानालिङ्गानि सर्वशः॥१६॥
verses.english: Then filled with joy, the troops of the Pandavas struck up numerous musical instruments of various description and shape, from all sides.

verses.sanskrit: प्रावादयन्त संहृष्टाः पाण्डूनां तत्र सैनिकाः।  अपश्यन् स्मयमानाश्च सौभद्रस्य विचेष्टितम्॥१७॥
verses.english: Beholding that feat achieved by Subhadra's son, they were amazed. Then seeing their most implacable and arrogant adversary thus worsted,

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तवैरिणं दृप्तं दृष्ट्वा शत्रुं पराजितम्।  धर्ममारुतशक्राणामश्विनोः प्रतिमास्तथा॥१८॥
verses.english: The five mighty car-warriors, viz., the five sons of Draupadi bearing on their standards as device the images of Yama, Maruta, Indra and the Asuras, as also Satyaki, Chekitana, Dhrishtadyumna Sikhandin, the Kekaya brothers, Dhristaketu and the Matsyas, the Panchalas and the Srinjayas and the Pandavas, were all enraptured and then headed by Yudhishthira, they rushed to battle desirous of breaking through Drona's division.

verses.sanskrit: धारयन्तो ध्वजाग्रेषु द्रौपदेया महारथाः।  सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च धृष्टद्युम्नशिखण्डिनौ॥१९॥
केकया धृष्टकेतुश्च मत्स्याः पञ्चालसृञ्जयाः।  पाण्डवाश्च मुदा युक्ता युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः॥२०॥
अभ्यद्रवन्त त्वरिता द्रोणानीकं बिभित्सवः।  ततोऽभवन्महायुद्धं त्वदीयानां परैः सह॥२१॥
जयमाकांक्षमाणानां शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्।  तथा तु वर्तमाने वै संग्रामेऽतिभयङ्करे॥२२॥
verses.english: Then there commenced a fierce battle between the the foe and your troops, all unretreating heroes, bent on achieving victory.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनो महाराज राधेयमिदमब्रवीत्।  पश्य दुःशासनं वीरमभिमन्युवशं गतम्॥२३॥
प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यं निघ्नन्तं शात्रवान् रणे।  अथ चैते सुसंरब्धाः सिंहा इव बलोत्कटाः॥२४॥
verses.english: Behold the heroic Dushasana worsted by Abhimanyu he who had been ere now slaying and scorching the foe like the sun himself.

verses.sanskrit: सौभद्रमुद्यतास्त्रातुमभ्यधावन्त पाण्डवाः।  ततः कर्णः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैरभिमन्युं दुरासदम्॥२५॥
verses.english: Yonder rushes the infuriate Pandavas, looking like so many mighty lions, with weapons uplifted, to the rescue of Subhadra's son.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यवर्षत संक्रुद्धः पुत्रस्य हितकृत् तव।  तस्य चानुचरांस्तीक्ष्णैर्विव्याध परमेषुभिः॥२६॥
verses.english: Thereupon inflamed with wrath Karna ever bent on doing good to your son, covered the arrows.

verses.sanskrit: अवज्ञापूर्वकं शूरः सौभद्रस्य रणाजिरे।  अभिमन्युस्तु राधेयं त्रिसप्तत्या शिलीमुखैः॥२७॥
verses.english: Then as if in contempt, the valiant Karna pierced the followers of Subhadra's son in battle with sharp shafts of excellent make.

verses.sanskrit: अविध्यत्त्वरितो राजन् द्रोणं प्रेप्सुर्महामनाः।  तं तथा नाशकत् कश्चिद्द्रोणाद्वारयितुं रथी॥२८॥
verses.english: Thereupon the high-souled Abhimanyu, who was longing to meet Drona himself, quickly pierced, o king, Radha's son with seventy-three shafts all whetted on stone.

verses.sanskrit: आरुजन्तं रथव्रातान् वज्रहस्तात्मजात्मजम्।  ततः कर्णो जयप्रेप्सुर्मानी सर्वधनुष्मताम्॥२९॥
verses.english: Then there was no car-warrior save and except Drona himself who could have checked that grandson of the wielder of the thunderbolt, who had then been afflicting the mighty carwarriors sorely.

verses.sanskrit: सौभद्रं शतशोऽविध्यदुत्तमास्त्राणि दर्शयन्।  सोऽस्त्रैरस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठो रामशिष्यः प्रतापवान्॥३०॥
verses.english: Thereafter displaying many many excellent weapons, Karna, that most honoured of all bowmen, desirous of victory pierced Subhadra's son with hundreds of shafts. Then that puissant pupil of Rama, that foremost of all men learned in the use of weapons, began to afflict Abhimanyu who was incapable of being vanquished by the foe.

verses.sanskrit: समरे शत्रुदुर्धर्षमभिमन्युमपीडयत्।  स तथा पीड्यमानस्तु राधेयेनास्त्रवृष्टिभिः॥३१॥
समरेऽमरसंकाशः सौभद्रो न व्यशीर्यत।  ततः शिलाशितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भल्लैरानतपर्वभिः॥३२॥
verses.english: Though thus afflicted with showers of weapons hurled by Radha's son, yet the son of Subhadra equal to an immortal, did not flinch.

verses.sanskrit: छित्त्वा धनूंषि शूराणामार्जुनिः कर्णमार्दयत्।  धनुर्मण्डलनिर्मुक्तैः शरैराशीविषोपमैः॥३३॥
verses.english: Thereafter having cut-off the bows of warriors, with broad-headed shafts of depressed knots all whetted on stone, Arjuna's son began to afflict Karna in return.

verses.sanskrit: सच्छत्रध्वजयन्तारं साश्वमाशु स्मयन्निव।  कर्णोऽपि चास्य चिक्षेप बाणान् सन्नतपर्वणः॥३४॥
verses.english: Then as if smiling he pierced the invincible Abhimanyu together with his umbrella, standard, charioteer and steeds with ten sharp arrows.

verses.sanskrit: असंभ्रान्तश्च तान्सर्वानगृह्णात् फाल्गुनात्मजः।  ततो मुहूर्तात् कर्णस्य बाणेनैकेन वीर्यवान्॥३५॥
verses.english: Then Karna sped at him five shafts of straight-knots; but the son of Phalguna dauntlessly received all those arrows.

verses.sanskrit: सध्वजं कार्मुकं वीरश्छित्त्वा भूमावपातयत्। ततः कृछ्रगतं कर्णं दृष्ट्वा कर्णादनन्तरः॥३६॥
verses.english: Then that valiant hero in a moment cutting off with a single shaft Karna's bow and standard, felled them to the ground.

verses.sanskrit: सौभद्रमभ्ययात् तुर्णं दृढमुद्यम्य कार्मुकम्। तत उच्चुक्रुशुः पार्थस्तेषां चानुचरा जनाः। वादित्राणि च संजघ्नुः सौभद्रं चापि तुष्टुवुः॥३७॥
